mapper.sql: SELECT merged.enterprise_id AS enterprise_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(merged.guarantee_amount), 0) AS guarantee_amount, COALESCE(SUM(merged.premium_amount), 0) AS premium_amount, COALESCE(SUM(merged.order_kind = 'TENDER'), 0) AS tender_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(merged.order_kind = 'PERFORMANCE'), 0) AS performance_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT merged.project_id) AS project_count FROM ( SELECT 'TENDER' AS order_kind, enterprise_id, project_id, guarantee_amount, premium_amount FROM tender_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PERFORMANCE' AS order_kind, enterprise_id, project_id, guarantee_amount, premium_amount FROM performance_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) merged GROUP BY merged.enterprise_id

en.id AS id, en.ent_code AS entCode, en.ent_name AS entName, en.credit_code AS creditCode, en.region_code AS regionCode, en.region_name AS regionName, en.industry AS industry, en.ent_level AS entLevel, en.contact_name AS contactName, en.contact_phone AS contactPhone, en.status AS status, COALESCE(agg.order_count, 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(agg.guarantee_amount, 0) AS totalGuaranteeAmount
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT merged.project_id), 0) AS projectCount, COALESCE(SUM(merged.order_kind = 'TENDER'), 0) AS tenderOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(merged.order_kind = 'PERFORMANCE'), 0) AS performanceOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(merged.premium_amount), 0) AS totalPremiumAmount FROM ( SELECT 'TENDER' AS order_kind, project_id, premium_amount FROM tender_order WHERE enterprise_id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PERFORMANCE' AS order_kind, project_id, premium_amount FROM performance_order WHERE enterprise_id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 ) merged
